stated_purpose: Local weather forecasts and rain alerts.
policy_text:
SkyCast Weather Privacy Policy:

1. Location: We collect your approximate location to show the forecast for your area.
2. Photos: You can share weather photos with the community if you choose to share them.
3. Contact: If you have questions, contact us at support@skycast.example and we will reply within 7 days.
terms_text:

By using the app you agree to our Privacy Policy. You grant us a worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, copy and display any photos you upload. We may share usage data with our advertising partners. We may modify these terms at any time without notice.
